27.q: Which nation has played in more World Cup finals?
27.period: Every World Cup, 1930 to 2026 (West Germany counts as Germany)
27.notes: All raw values confirmed. The 2026 final (19 July 2026, MetLife Stadium) was Spain 1-0 Argentina after extra time (Ferran Torres, 106th minute), so Spain have 2 finals (2010, 2026) and Argentina 7 (1930, 1978, 1986, 1990, 2014, 2022, 2026). Germany 8 includes West Germany (1954, 1966, 1974, 1982, 1986, 1990) and Germany (2002, 2014). Brazil 7 counts the 1950 deciding match v Uruguay, which Wikipedia and FIFA treat as the final though it was technically a final-group game; without it Brazil have 6.
